annotations.title: JWT decode: decode a JWT token's header and payload and check its expiry

description: JWT decode without a key: the header and payload of a JSON Web Token (the signature is not verified), with issued-at, not-before and expiry as dates and whether it has expired. The token is not stored. Do not use the result to trust a token. Use to debug auth flows. Example: token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjMiLCJleHAiOjE3OTIyODE2MDB9.sig. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
